lookup_language_name: lookup the full language name from a language code using LANGUAGE_CODE_TO_NAME
create_language_mapping: create a reverse mapping from language names to language codes using LANGUAGE_CODE_TO_NAME
summarize_language_codes: summarize all supported language codes and their full names from LANGUAGE_CODE_TO_NAME
test_language_lookup: test the LANGUAGE_CODE_TO_NAME dictionary for valid code-to-name mappings
review_language_coverage: review the LANGUAGE_CODE_TO_NAME dictionary for language coverage and completeness
